_comment: Repo-managed opencode permission block, merged into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json by /deploy-global (opencode scope). Additive and idempotent; a rule already present in the user's config wins. Leading ~ is expanded to $HOME at merge time so this file stays portable. Every entry is a directory opencode must reach WITHOUT an interactive prompt, because an unattended run (status-fetch, a spawned subagent) has nobody to answer it. The deploy discovers and validates an installed Bash 5+ only when the user has no `shell` key.
